title: Kestrel and the Orchard
author: Coral Ashgrove
blurb: Cyrus Winterbourne, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
